newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore gas oil swaps hit fresh record high.
newsitem.headline: Singapore gas oil swaps hit fresh record high.

text.p: Singapore gas oil front-month swaps traded earlier Thursday at a record high of $28.25 per barrel on renewed tension between Iraq and the United States, brokers said.
October gas oil swaps were strongly bid by both oil majors, traders and banks, one broker said.
Earlier on Thursday, October swaps traded at $28.05 and $28.20. October swaps were last quoted at $28.25/$28.40.
Traders said the market rose on fears the U.S. would launch a new military attack on Iraq after Iraq fired a surface-to-air missile at two U.S. jets late on Wednesday.
The previous gas oil swaps record was set last week, when U.S. fired 44 missiles on southern Iraqi military targets, with an October trade at $28.10.
